units.source_text: 薰君就以此为发端，常常到这藤侍从的住处来访晤，其间隐约吐露向女公子求爱之意。

en.t: Lord Kaoru took this as an opening and often came to visit Fuji no Jijuu at his residence, while faintly hinting at his wish to court the young lady.

units.source_text: 藏人少将诗中的推量果然不错，这里的人对薰君都怀着好感。

en.t: The guess that the Kuroudo Major had made in his poem was indeed correct: everyone here felt warmly toward Lord Kaoru.

units.source_text: 藤侍从的童心也向往他，把他当作好友，很想朝夕和他亲近。

en.t: Fuji no Jijuu, with his childlike heart, admired him too, treated him as a good friend, and longed to be close to him morning and evening.
